description: This PHP source file defines the `LangStringHelper` class used within the OrangeHRM system to manage internationalization language strings, including database operations such as insert, update, delete, and retrieval of language string data related to localization groups.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing language string data in the database, including CRUD operations and batch insert/update of localization strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new query builder instance for building SQL queries.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LanguageHelper for localization tasks.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a localization group by its name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings and their definitions that are not marked as customized within a specific group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all language string IDs belonging to a specified group.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Gets IDs of language strings that are not marked as customized in the database for a given group.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads YAML language strings from a directory and inserts or updates them in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Finds the ID of a language string by its value and optionally group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Finds the ID of a language string based on its unit ID and group.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string record into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record with new data.
